messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
(For each entry, the “Long weekend” column shows the full stretch of days that people usually enjoy off, including the holiday itself.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Long weekend (days) |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|---------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (New Year’s Day) |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18–20** (Family Day) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7–9** (Good Friday to Easter Monday) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | **May 20–22** (Victoria Day) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2–4** (Labour Day) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7–9** (Thanksgiving) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Remembrance Day) |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23–25** (Christmas Day) |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | **Dec 24–26** (Boxing Day) |

> **Note:** Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If your app needs province‑specific long weekends, let me know!
